verdict.rationale: Background automation, such as scheduled transfers, sweep rules or recurring payouts, is a fair axis for a money-management platform. The evidence pack documents no user-configurable automation feature in Treasury. What it does show are APIs and events a developer could build automations from (OutboundPayments, transaction.created events), plus adjacent automatic behaviors (Stripe-run risk controls, self-updating disclosures). None of these count as the capability itself.
